High Protein chicken lasagna 4 Portions:
500-600g minced chicken
1 Onion
1 Zucchini
2 Carrots
1 Can of tomatoes (400g)
4 cloves of garlic
2 Tbsp Tomatoepaste
1 Tbsp Bouillon
400g Cottage cheese
50-100ml milk
nutmeg
about 10 lasagna sheets
100g Parmesan cheese
Olive oil
Spices
Casserole dish

Chop all the vegetables in small squares. Sauté the onions and the garlic in a pot. Add the tomatoe paste and some paprika powder and roast it a little. Add the carrots and the zucchini. Add a little water all few minutes to steam the vegetables. In a pan add the minced chicken, season with salt, pepper and paprika. Fry it until cooked through. Set aside. When the vegetables are soft, add the chicken, the tomatoes and some water. Reduce and season with bouillon and spices. In a blender add the cottage cheese and some milk (Amount depends on your goal consistency). Add nutmeg, salt and pepper. In the dish first add tomatoesauce, lasagna sheets and the "béchamel", tomatoesauce, ... End it with tomatoe sauce and finish with parmesan cheese. Bake at 180° C for about 30 min. 1 Portion is about 600 Kcal and 50g of Proteins
